findings.passage: Every fraudulent vote cancels out a legitimate vote cast by a law-abiding citizen. With 84 percent of Americans supporting photo ID for voting, the SAVE America Act delivers the accountability and transparency voters expect and deserve.
findings.note: Quote in his official press release after the House vote on the SAVE America Act. He cites public support for photo ID for voting.

findings.passage: I applaud the House passage of the SAVE America Act, and I strongly encourage the Senate to bring this bill to the floor for an open debate.
findings.note: He urges the Senate to take up the SAVE America Act.

findings.passage: At a time when more than 15 million illegal immigrants have entered the country under the Biden-Harris Administration, Congress must act to protect the integrity of federal elections and restore trust in our democratic system.
findings.note: He links the bill to non-citizen entry and trust in federal elections.

findings.passage: Today, Congressman Dan Meuser (PA-09) voted in favor of the Safeguarding American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) America Act, commonsense legislation that strengthens election integrity by requiring government-issued photo identification to vote and documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections.
findings.note: Press release text issued in his name stating he voted for the SAVE America Act and describing it as requiring government-issued photo ID to vote and documentary proof of citizenship to register for federal elections. The release does not describe what happens to a voter without ID.
